eyebrow: A QUIET PLACE ON THE INTERNET
subtitle: The Path Within
intro1: There is nowhere you need to be.
intro2: Just a lake, a little light, and a moment to yourself.
disclaimer: Inspired by contemplative traditions · Not a depiction of Nirvana
gently: Let the world move gently around you.
footnote: No scores. No rush. Nothing to prove.
msgLight: A light joins the lake. May all beings be well.
msgDone: Your quiet moment is complete. Stay as long as you wish.
msgSit: Take your time. You can leave whenever you wish.
msgWater: The water reflects the changing sky.
msgNoAudio: Audio is unavailable in this browser.
msgSlow: Lights drift slowly. Try again in a moment.
msgOffline: The shared lake is out of reach. You are on your own lake for now.
noWebgl: This browser cannot display the 3D lake (WebGL is unavailable). The stillness timer still works.
sitBody: Rest naturally. Notice the sounds, the space, the breath.
reducedHint: Gentler camera motion and still lanterns
shareHint: See other wanderers and their lights. Only your random name, position and lanterns are sent; nothing is stored.
privacy: This version works without an account. No personal reflections are collected.
helpBody: Walk around the lake and find a place that feels right. You do not need to complete anything.
hZoom: Move the view closer or farther
hLight: Add a floating lantern to the lake
hShare: Optional: quietly see others. No chat, no profiles.
musicHint: Slow drone and chimes that never repeat, tuned to A = 432 Hz
alphaHint: A gentle 10 Hz beat between left and right ear. Best with headphones. A sound texture, not a treatment.
